title: Reba: In Concert
overview: "Reba in Concert" (1991) is a celebrated live performance by country music star Reba McEntire, originally released on VHS in August 1991. Filmed in 1990 at the Frank Erwin Center in Austin, Texas, the concert serves as a poignant tribute, as it features seven of her band members and her tour manager who tragically died in a plane crash.
